actions.name: windows.graphics.runtime-rollback
actions.label: Reverter runtime gráfico
actions.command: linux/pz windows-vm graphics runtime rollback --backup latest --json
actions.plan_command: linux/pz windows-vm graphics runtime rollback --backup latest --dry-run --json

actions.name: ai.routing-plan
actions.label: Plano Código · Equilibrado (diff)
actions.command: linux/pz ai routing plan --task code --client claude

actions.name: ai.routing-apply-all
actions.label: Aplicar 3 rotas · Equilibrado
actions.command: linux/pz ai routing apply --task code --policy balanced --yes
actions.plan_command: linux/pz ai routing apply --task code --policy balanced --dry-run
